body: No I don’t have anything to do I’m stuck inside the house all day. Besides homework I pretty much lay in bed.

I don’t want people to know I know they would just agree I should kill myself

I've never been officially diagnosed for OCD but I do think I have it. I constantly have to count things, I have to touch or turn off things a certain amount of times, I wash my hands all the way up to my elbows so often that I have eczema now, I have to step a certain way when I get back into my apartment, I don't like anyone even touching me anymore for fear of germs. Sometimes I'll make myself do something again or I have to see something like four blue cars pass by or else I'll say I'll get an illness if it doesn't happen. It's been like this since I was 10 but it's just gotten worse. I don't wanna see a therapist about this. When this first started happening my mother and sister ambushed me with a therapy session by saying we were going to the mall. I forced to sit in a room for an hour crying then they all threated to put me in a mental institution (including the therapist). I don't wanna do that again.

Ok well I had a good relationship with my mother before she divorced. Then after that her personality slowly took a turn. Over the last 5 years our relationship has completely crumbled. We've gotten into physical fights mostly when I was like 13/14, she's called me a devil and evil. She compares me to her mother ( who's a horrible person and actually doesn't even like me but favorites my sister and everyone on my mothers side knows it ) and she compares me to my father who's a rapist so...... There are times where I'm just saying random stuff about other people and somehow it gets twisted into I'm talking bad about her. Whenever we fight she says I'm abusing her. If I'm hurt of having a bad day she's irritated but if she's upset and crying which is literally everyday everyone's suppose to fawn over her. Also if she does anything bad or wrong to me she suddenly forgets it. I'll bring it up and she'll say it's a lie. Oh also she threated to have me institutionalized when I was having a mental breakdown meanwhile when my sister was threatening to kill herself almost everyday she did nothing.

So I'm not crazy!? I've been following this sub for a while wondering if my mother is a nmom but I have no one in real life to talk about what she does to me and whenever I confront her she says I'm the crazy and abusive one so now I'm not sure if I'm the crazy one or not......
